questions.text: Which of the following are key metrics to monitor for an LLM in production? Select all that apply.
options: Latency (time to first token and total response time)
Token throughput and cost per request
The color scheme of the monitoring dashboard
Error rates and response quality scores
questions.explanation: Key LLM production metrics include latency (time to first token and total response time), token throughput, cost per request, error rates, and response quality scores. The visual appearance of a dashboard is a UI concern, not a model performance metric.

questions.text: What does drift detection identify in an LLM system?
options: Physical movement of the servers running the model
Changes in input data distributions or model output quality over time that deviate from expected baselines
The speed at which new model versions are deployed
Network latency between the client and the API endpoint
questions.explanation: Drift detection monitors for shifts in the statistical properties of incoming data (data drift) or degradation in model performance (model drift) compared to established baselines. This helps identify when a model needs retraining or when user behavior has changed significantly.

questions.text: Why is prompt versioning important in LLM applications?
options: It allows teams to track changes to prompts over time, compare performance across versions, and roll back to previous versions if a new prompt degrades output quality
It is only needed for regulatory compliance and has no practical engineering benefit
It automatically improves the model's accuracy without any human intervention
It reduces the token count of every prompt by compressing text
questions.explanation: Prompt versioning enables teams to maintain a history of prompt changes, run A/B tests to compare effectiveness, attribute performance changes to specific prompt edits, and quickly roll back if a new version causes regressions. It is a practical engineering practice essential for reliable LLM operations.

questions.text: What should a comprehensive LLM logging strategy capture?
options: Only the final output text, nothing else
The full request (prompt, parameters, metadata), the response, latency, token usage, and any errors or guardrail triggers
Only error messages when the model fails
Only the model name and timestamp
questions.explanation: A comprehensive logging strategy captures the full request context (prompt, system message, parameters, user metadata), the complete response, performance metrics (latency, token counts), cost data, and any safety or guardrail events. This enables debugging, auditing, and continuous improvement.

questions.text: Which of the following is a best practice for alerting in LLM observability?
options: Send an alert for every single request to ensure nothing is missed
Never set up alerts because they create too much noise
Define threshold-based alerts for critical metrics like error rate spikes, latency increases, and cost anomalies, with appropriate severity levels to avoid alert fatigue
Only alert when the model is completely offline and ignore all degradation signals
questions.explanation: Effective alerting uses well-defined thresholds on critical metrics with appropriate severity tiers. Alerting on every request creates noise and fatigue, while no alerts leaves the team blind to issues. The best approach balances sensitivity with actionability, escalating based on impact severity.

questions.text: Care dintre urmatoarele sunt metrici cheie de monitorizat pentru un LLM in productie? Selectati toate variantele corecte.
options: Latenta (timpul pana la primul token si timpul total de raspuns)
Debitul de tokeni si costul per cerere
Schema de culori a tabloului de bord de monitorizare
Ratele de eroare si scorurile de calitate a raspunsurilor
questions.explanation: Metricile cheie de productie pentru LLM includ latenta (timpul pana la primul token si timpul total de raspuns), debitul de tokeni, costul per cerere, ratele de eroare si scorurile de calitate a raspunsurilor. Aspectul vizual al unui tablou de bord este o preocupare de interfata, nu o metrica de performanta a modelului.

questions.text: Ce identifica detectia derivei intr-un sistem LLM?
options: Miscarea fizica a serverelor care ruleaza modelul
Modificari in distributiile datelor de intrare sau in calitatea outputului modelului in timp, care deviaza de la nivelurile de baza asteptate
Viteza cu care sunt implementate noi versiuni ale modelului
Latenta retelei intre client si endpoint-ul API
questions.explanation: Detectia derivei monitorizeaza schimbarile in proprietatile statistice ale datelor de intrare (deriva datelor) sau degradarea performantei modelului (deriva modelului) fata de nivelurile de baza stabilite. Aceasta ajuta la identificarea momentului cand un model necesita reantrenare sau cand comportamentul utilizatorilor s-a schimbat semnificativ.

questions.text: De ce este important versionarea prompturilor in aplicatiile LLM?
options: Permite echipelor sa urmareasca modificarile prompturilor in timp, sa compare performanta intre versiuni si sa revina la versiuni anterioare daca un prompt nou degradeaza calitatea outputului
Este necesara doar pentru conformitatea reglementara si nu are niciun beneficiu practic de inginerie
Imbunatateste automat acuratetea modelului fara nicio interventie umana
Reduce numarul de tokeni al fiecarui prompt prin comprimarea textului
questions.explanation: Versionarea prompturilor permite echipelor sa mentina un istoric al modificarilor, sa ruleze teste A/B pentru a compara eficacitatea, sa atribuie schimbarile de performanta unor editari specifice ale prompturilor si sa revina rapid daca o noua versiune cauzeaza regresii. Este o practica de inginerie esentiala pentru operatiunile fiabile cu LLM.

questions.text: Ce ar trebui sa capteze o strategie cuprinzatoare de logare pentru LLM?
options: Doar textul final de output, nimic altceva
Cererea completa (prompt, parametri, metadate), raspunsul, latenta, utilizarea tokenilor si orice erori sau declansari ale parapetelor de siguranta
Doar mesajele de eroare cand modelul esueaza
Doar numele modelului si marcajul temporal
questions.explanation: O strategie cuprinzatoare de logare capteaza contextul complet al cererii (prompt, mesaj de sistem, parametri, metadate utilizator), raspunsul complet, metricile de performanta (latenta, numarul de tokeni), datele de cost si orice evenimente de siguranta sau ale parapetelor. Aceasta permite depanarea, auditul si imbunatatirea continua.

questions.text: Care dintre urmatoarele este o buna practica pentru alertare in observabilitatea LLM?
options: Trimiterea unei alerte pentru fiecare cerere individuala pentru a nu rata nimic
Sa nu configurezi niciodata alerte deoarece creeaza prea mult zgomot

Definirea alertelor bazate pe praguri pentru metrici critice precum cresteri bruste ale ratei de eroare, cresteri de latenta si anomalii de cost, cu niveluri de severitate adecvate pentru a evita oboseala de alerte
Alertarea doar cand modelul este complet offline si ignorarea tuturor semnalelor de degradare
questions.explanation: Alertarea eficienta foloseste praguri bine definite pentru metricile critice cu niveluri de severitate adecvate. Alertarea la fiecare cerere creeaza zgomot si oboseala, in timp ce absenta alertelor lasa echipa oarba la probleme. Cea mai buna abordare echilibreaza sensibilitatea cu posibilitatea de actiune, escaladand pe baza severitatii impactului.

questions.text: Poia apo ta parakatoi einai vasikes metrikes gia tin parakoloythisi enos LLM stin paragogi? Epilexte oles tis sostes apantiseis.
options: Kathisteriisi (chronos mechri to proto token kai synolikos chronos apantisis)
Rythmapodosi token kai kostos ana aitima
To chromatiko schema tou pinaka parakoloythisis
Pososta sfalmaton kai vathmologiies poiotitas apantiseon
questions.explanation: Oi vasikes metrikes paragogis LLM perilamvanoun tin kathisteriisi (chronos mechri to proto token kai synolikos chronos apantisis), ti rythmapodosi token, to kostos ana aitima, ta pososta sfalmaton kai tis vathmologiies poiotitas apantiseon. I optiki emfanisi enos pinaka einai thema diepaphis, ochi metriiki apodosis montelou.

questions.text: Ti entopizzei i anichneusi ektropis se ena systima LLM?
options: Ti fysiki metakinisi ton server pou ekteloun to montelo
Allages stis katanomes dedomenon eisodou i stin poiotita exodou tou montelou me ton kairo pou parekkllinoun apo ta anamennomena vasika epipeda
Tin tachytita me tin opoia anaptyssontai nees ekdoseis montelou
Tin kathisteriisi diktyou metaxy tou pelati kai tou telikoy simeiou API
questions.explanation: I anichneusi ektropis parakolouthei tis metavoles stis statistikes idiiotites ton eiserchhomenon dedomenon (ektropi dedomenon) i tin ypovathmisi tis apodosis tou montelou (ektropi montelou) se sygkrisi me ta kathieromenna vasika epipeda. Ayto voithai ston entopismo tou pote ena montelo chreiazzzetai epaanekpaideysi i pote i symperifora ton christon echei allaxei simantika.

questions.text: Giati einai simantiki i ekdosiopoiisi prompton stis efarmogeis LLM?
options: Epitrepei stis omades na parakolouthoun tis allages sta prompts me ton kairo, na sygkrrinoun tin apodosi metaxy ekdoseon kai na epistrefoun se proigoumenes ekdoseis an ena neo prompt ypovathmizei tin poiotita exodou
Chreiazzetai mono gia tin kanonistiki symmorfoosi kai den echei kanena praktiko ofelos michanikis
Veltionei aytomata tin akrivia tou montelou choris kamia anthropini paremvasi
Meionei ton arithmo token kathe prompt sympiezzointas to keimeno
questions.explanation: I ekdosiopoiisi prompton epitrepei stis omades na diatiroun ena istoriko allagon, na ekteloun dokimes A/B gia sygkrisi apotelesmatikotitas, na apodiidoun allages apodosis se sygkekrimenes epexergasies prompton kai na epistrefoun grigora an mia nea ekdosi prokalei palindromiseis. Einai mia praktiki michanikis apaiaitiiti gia axiopistes leitougies LLM.

questions.text: Ti prepei na katachrafei mia periektiki stratigiki katachorissis LLM?
options: Mono to teliko keimeno exodou, tipota allo
To plires aitima (prompt, parametrous, metadedomena), tin apantisi, tin kathisteriisi, tin chrisi token kai opoiadipote sfalmata i enerrgopoiiseis prostateytikon mechanismon
Mono ta minimata sfalmaton otan to montelo apotyganei
Mono to onoma tou montelou kai tin chronosfragida
questions.explanation: Mia periektiki stratigiki katachorissis katachrafei to plires plaisio tou aitimatos (prompt, minima systimatos, parametrous, metadedomena christi), tin pliri apantisi, tis metrikes apodosis (kathisteriisi, arithmo token), ta dedomena kostous kai opoiadipote gegonota asfaleias. Ayto epitrepei tin aposfalmadosi, ton elengcho kai ti synechi veltioosi.

questions.text: Poia apo tis parakatoi einai mia kalii praktiki gia tin eidopoiisi stin parakoloythisi LLM?
options: Apostoli eidopoiisis gia kathe xechoristo aitima gia na min chathei tipota
Na min rythmisete pote eidopoiiseis epidi dimiourgoun ypervolliko thoruvo

Orismos eidopoiiseon vasismeon se katoflia gia kritikes metrikes opos apotomes ayxiseis tou posostou sfalmaton, ayxiseis kathisteriisis kai anomalies kostous, me katallila epipeda sfodrotitas gia tin apofygi tis kourasis apo eidopoiiseis
Eidopoiisi mono otan to montelo einai pliros ektos syntontismou kai agnoissi olon ton simatoon ypovathmiisis
questions.explanation: I apotelesmatiki eidopoiisi chrisimopoiei kaloa orismenoa kaatoflia se kritikes metrikes me katallila epipeda svvarotitas. I eidopoiisi se kathe aitima dimioyrgei thoruvo kai koyrasi, enoi i apoysia eidopoiiseon afinei tin omada tyfli sta problimata. I kalyyteri proseggisi exissorrroopei tin evaisthhisia me ti dynatotita drasis, klimakonointas vaasei tis sfoodrotitas ton epidraseon.
